notes: The appositional even is added: rule 16 gives that word only to a marker standing on the very phrase it introduces, and no object marker stands anywhere in this verse.
אִשֶּׁה is headed on fire rather than the generic offering, following rule 31's burnt offerings precedent; heading on offering was the competing reading.
The article of עַל־הַמַּעֲרֶכֶת takes the quantifying determiner each written where the phrase's the would stand (rule 41).
